title: Investiture Ceremony
text: Student leaders of 2026–27 received their badges, sashes and house flags.
body:
The Investiture Ceremony for 2026–27 welcomed the new student council to office. Head Girl, house captains and sports leaders stood on stage with their sashes and flags, ready to serve the school.

Teachers presented the house flags, and the student leaders accepted them as a promise to lead with integrity and respect. The ceremony reminded everyone that leadership is not about being in charge. It is about inspiring others and working together for a better tomorrow.

It was a proud morning for the school, as the new team stepped forward to guide their houses and set an example for every Lawrence student.
